claims.statement: The Commission identifies verification rules and an accreditation framework for checking embedded emissions in the definitive CBAM regime.
The definitive regime creates ongoing importer reporting and compliance workflows supported by a dedicated registry.

economics.acquisition_route: Bundle with customs and CBAM software partners rather than sell importer by importer
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 2500 annual engagements across the EU at 2500 PLN net revenue could yield 6.25m PLN revenue and over 5m PLN founder equity in years 5-7
economics.founder_time: 2-4 hours/day; assurance decisions remain with accredited firms
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 65-80% after document triage and support
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 1000-3000 PLN reservation fee plus 5-8% of completed engagement
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual verification cycles and additions of suppliers or covered goods

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Capacity, sector-acceptance and cycle-time data improve routing and become a defensible scheduling layer
fingerprint.customer: Polish/EU CBAM importers and accredited verification firms
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Customs brokers, importer associations and direct partnerships with early accredited verifiers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Accreditation-scoped capacity calendar, conflict screening, document completeness scoring and cancellable reservations
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Importer pays reservation and preparation fees; verifier pays only on completed engagement
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An importer approaches a reporting deadline without suitable verification capacity

founder_fit: No inventory or public persona required

structure.control_point: cross-verifier availability calendar plus importer readiness score
structure.critical_dependency: A sufficient number of accredited verifiers must permit third-party scheduling and referral fees

thesis: Give importers a narrow marketplace to reserve future accredited-verifier capacity by sector, geography and deadline, with standardized pre-audit packets that reduce wasted expert time.
title: CBAM Verifier Capacity Reservation Exchange
uncertainties: Capacity scarcity, fees and buyer conversion are unvalidated
Referral-fee acceptability must be checked jurisdiction by jurisdiction
